spans.s:
श्चुत् 1. श्चुत् or 1. श्च्युत् (perhaps fr. a
noun formed fr. an original rt. श्च्यु; cf.
rts. 1. च्यु, 2. च्युत्), cl. 1. P. श्चोतति or श्च्योतति,
चुश्चोत or चुश्च्योत, अश्चुतत्, अश्चोतीत्, &c., श्चोतितुम्
or श्च्योतितुम्, to ooze, trickle, flow, exude, drop,
[]
distil; to sprinkle, scatter, diffuse, shed, pour out;
Pass. श्चुत्यते, Aor. अश्चोति, &c.: Caus. श्चोतयति,
&c.; [cf. Goth. skevjan, skura; Angl. Sax. scur.]

2. श्चुत् or 2. श्च्युत्, त्, त्, त्, distilling, sprinkling,
shedding, (at the end of comps., e. g. जल-श्˚, shed-
ding or sprinkling water.)

श्चुतित or श्च्युतित, अस्, आ, अम्, oozed, exuded,
issued, sprinkled, shed; oozing, dropping, flowing.

श्चुतित्वा, ind. having oozed, having exuded or
flowed.
